description: Read the PROOF-LINKED COMMEMORATIVE. With no id, the pinned notice with its version and the hash a request names, the house price (blank by default, and then none is quoted) and how many records are held. With recordId, one record: the packet it commemorates, its hashes and its time, never a wallet. It says plainly that a commemorative gives no right to anything and is not a token, money or a certificate. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, and until then the notice read says so plainly; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

recordId.description: One record's id (the recordId it was made under). Leave it out to read the notice and the price.

name: net_collectible_status
title: Read the commemorative notice and house price, or one commemorative record by its id
